children: Gevo, Inc. announced a three-year agreement with CEEZER to sell carbon removal credits from its North Dakota CCS project, part of a path the company says could support a carbon business exceeding $30M in annual revenue from existing operations.
Validates recurring revenue from carbon removals; supports multi-year demand.
Indicates material volume commitment; enhances revenue visibility.
Signals potential scale of the carbon business from existing ops.
Durable removals can price at a premium; supports margins.
Adds to growing CDR sales portfolio
Portfolio effect reduces customer concentration risk.

This extends Gevo’s push to monetize its CCS/BECCS assets with recurring, multi-year CDR offtakes—an early-to-mid shift toward a repeatable revenue stream. A larger catalyst would be disclosure of pricing, total contract value, and additional multi-year deals scaling toward the $30M+ target.
